title: Roles
description: Built-in roles can't be changed. A custom role opens the same parts of the admin as the role it's based on and has its own content permissions.

list.userCount: {count, plural, =0 {No users} one {# user} other {# users}}

builtInDescriptions.admin: Full access, including users, settings and API keys
builtInDescriptions.editor: Creates, edits, publishes and deletes content
builtInDescriptions.contributor: Creates and edits content; cannot publish

form.description: A custom role starts with the content permissions of the role it's based on. Narrow them down on the permissions page.
form.label: Label
form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: Saved as {name}. Users and permissions refer to it, so it can't be changed later.
form.nameHelpEmpty: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. It can't be changed later.
form.baseRoleHelp: Decides which parts of the admin the role can open.
form.baseRoleEditHelp: Changes which parts of the admin the role can open. Saved content permissions stay as they are.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the role “{label}”?
deleteDialog.description: Its content permissions are deleted too.
deleteDialog.inUse: {count, plural, one {# user still has} other {# users still have}} this role. Give them another role first.

toasts.inUse: {count, plural, one {# user still has} other {# users still have}} this role. Give them another role first.
